Daily Devotional

October 26

9 For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily. 10 And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power: (Colossians 2:9-10 KJV)

WOW! What a revelation this is, that in Jesus dwells the fullness of God, and we are complete in Jesus, meaning that in the Spirit we have present with us the full Godhead, if we are born again believers in Jesus. That means that we are, with Jesus, the head of all principality and powers, and contain the fullness of God in our Spirits. The Grace of God has given us more then we can comprehend, and it is not because of anything we have done, but is all due to the love that God has for us. If the born again Christian would only realize what all they have been given, they would live the life of abundance that God intends us to live. It even includes the raising from the dead power that God used to raise Jesus from the dead (Romans 8:11) – WOW!

Although we have the power of God living within us, it does not mean that we can just exercise that power for anything we want. The Grace of God that gives us so very much, must be accessed by Faith, as that is what pleases God (Hebrews 11:6), for without Faith in what God has provided by Grace, we can not realize the benefits of having all this power in our spirits. This is why Jesus said if we can believe, all things are possible to those that believe (Mark 9:23). Remember that we can do all things through Christ who strengthens us (Philippians 4:13). As we access the power of God through Faith, we can get our healing, prosperity, and deliverance that His Grace provides for us. Does that mean we can get whatever we want? No, we can only obtain the things that God has already given us by His Grace. That includes all the things promised in the Word of God, so read the bible and learn what all we can obtain through our Faith. Praise God for Jesus!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
